attributes.board_name: Tennessee Board of Communication Disorders and Sciences

rules.accepted_credit_types: The Board does not pre-approve programs; licensees judge relevance. 0.1 ASHA CEU = 60 minutes = 1 hour. Multi-media courses (live, asynchronous, blended, independent study via a Board-approved provider) count with a written post-test. Not accepted: regular work activities, staff meetings, board/committee service, unstructured self-learning, agency policy training, courses not related to SLP or audiology.
rules.new_licensee_rule: Education and training required for licensure completed in the 12 months before licensure counts as CE for the initial licensure period.
rules.audit_note: Attest on the biennial renewal form; keep CE documentation at least 4 years; produce certificates or sponsor letters if the Board asks. CE Broker is the Board's official (optional) tracking system.
rules.notes: Rule amended effective June 16, 2026: 20 hours in the two calendar years (Jan 1 - Dec 31) before the renewal year, at least 10 in the licensee's own area of practice. Dual SLP and audiology licensees need 20 hours split equally between the two specialties. The Board's CE web page still shows the older annual wording (10 hours per calendar year, 5 for SLPAs); the June 2026 rule text is used here. No mandatory topics; the Tennessee Jurisprudence Exam is required before licensure and reinstatement, not for routine renewal.
rules.rule_quote: (a) All Speech Language Pathologists and Audiologists must complete twenty (20) hours of continuing education during the two calendar years (January 1– December 31) that precede the licensure renewal year.

rules.accepted_credit_types: Same rules as for licensees; all hours may be multi-media with a post-test.
rules.new_licensee_rule: Education and training required for registration completed in the 12 months before registration counts as CE for the initial registration period.
rules.audit_note: Attest on the biennial renewal form; keep documentation at least 4 years.
rules.notes: Speech-language pathology assistants are registered (not licensed); minimum 10 hours in the two calendar years before the renewal year (rule effective June 16, 2026).
rules.rule_quote: (b) All Speech Language Pathology Assistants must complete a minimum of ten (10) hours of continuing education during the two (2) calendar years (January 1– December 31) that precede the licensure renewal year cycle.
